# The Homage Rule

<!-- Generated from canon by scripts/build_derived.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Evoke the genre, never the property.**

Themes borrow a genre's grammar: light, palette mood, type feel, camera language, edit rhythm and sound texture. They borrow nothing a studio owns. A style can't be owned, but logos, characters and specific creative expression can.

## Borrow the grammar

| Borrow | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Light | Neon, haze, gold, phosphor, daylight. |
| Palette mood | Night, dusk, archive, broadcast. |
| Type feel | Open-license faces with the right temperament. |
| Camera language | Push-ins, crawls, tracking shots, crash zooms. |
| Edit rhythm | On the beat, on twos, held pauses. |
| Sound texture | Hum, hiss, tape, room tone. Never a melody. |

## Never ship, at any theme or intensity

- Franchise names, logos, wordmarks or title-card lockups, including look-alike recreations.
- Characters, creatures, likenesses, costumes, or silhouettes that read as a specific character.
- Named places, organizations, ships, products or invented terms from the work.
- Quotes, catchphrases or recognizable dialogue.
- Scores, sound-alikes of a theme melody, or signature sound effects.
- Stills, frames, posters, or traced compositions of specific shots.
- The franchise's own typefaces. Use the open-license fonts on each card and record them in the manifest.

## Naming

Public pages, meta tags, alt text, repositories and client deliverables use the codename only ("TX-07 NIGHT DRIVE"), never a franchise name with "-style" after it. Internal briefs may name the inspiration. Nothing may imply endorsement or affiliation.

## The swap test

Picture the theme swapped for its nearest genre neighbor. Any element that only makes sense as one franchise's property gets cut or redesigned. Log homage-check: PASS or FAIL at the T stage.

## Commentary exception

A story that is about a film or franchise (a fan community, a review, a cultural analysis) may name it in copy as factual reference. It still uses no logos or studio assets, and carries the property's disclaimer where one exists. If a client asks for a licensed look, escalate to Barry.

## Theme guardrails

Each card adds its own off-limits list on top of the rule.

| Theme | Guardrails |
| --- | --- |
| [TX-01 VECTOR GRID](../themes/tx-01-vector-grid.md) | No light-racing vehicles, throwing-disc weapons or circuit-lined suits on human figures, and no recreated title styling. Keep the light abstract: lines, grids and shards. |
| [TX-02 PHOSPHOR RAIN](../themes/tx-02-phosphor-rain.md) | Rain glyphs come from the subject, never a borrowed or mirrored glyph set. No two-pill choice motif, no figures in long coats and dark glasses, no phone-booth exits, no film dialogue. |
| [TX-03 GLASS HUD](../themes/tx-03-glass-hud.md) | No armored suits or helmets, no named AI assistants from films, no gesture-glove props and no prediction-chamber imagery. |
| [TX-04 RAINLIGHT NOIR](../themes/tx-04-rainlight-noir.md) | No synthetic-human interrogation tests, origami figures, flying police vehicles, invented megacorporations, or recreated skyline shots. |
| [TX-05 STUTTER BROADCAST](../themes/tx-05-stutter-broadcast.md) | No recreation of an existing synthetic presenter's face, hair, wardrobe or name, and no lines from any show. Any AI host must be an original design. |
| [TX-06 OTHERSIDE ’83](../themes/tx-06-otherside-83.md) | No series title lockup or its typeface, no creatures or characters, no alphabet-light wall, no named town or lab, no kids-on-bikes silhouettes. |
| [TX-07 NIGHT DRIVE](../themes/tx-07-night-drive.md) | No recreations of specific TV openings, film title scripts or costume pieces, and no real car models or brands. |
| [TX-08 COLD STORAGE](../themes/tx-08-cold-storage.md) | No ship or onboard-computer names, no creature, egg or biomechanical forms, no film corporation logos, no franchise wordmark. |
| [TX-09 SPACE OPERA](../themes/tx-09-space-opera.md) | No famous opening line or its variants, no franchise logo or its crawl yellow, no glowing swords, ships, robots or helmets from films, no franchise terminology. |
| [TX-10 SANDSCALE](../themes/tx-10-sandscale.md) | No giant worms, desert survival suits, flapping-wing aircraft, noble-house sigils, invented resource names or glyph alphabets, and no custom wordmark. No black monolith slab either; that belongs to TX-12's genre. |
| [TX-11 WASTELAND CHROME](../themes/tx-11-wasteland-chrome.md) | No war-convoy vehicles, skull-and-wheel or faction emblems, characters, masks, flame-throwing guitars, or franchise names. |
| [TX-12 SLIT-SCAN COSMOS](../themes/tx-12-slit-scan-cosmos.md) | No black monolith, no red-eyed ship computer, no film ship designs, no bookshelf-dimension sets, no soundtrack recordings. |
| [TX-13 CLOCKWORK REALM](../themes/tx-13-clockwork-realm.md) | No noble-house sigils, continent shapes or place names from any series, no astrolabe-sun opener composition, no theme melody. |
| [TX-14 RED-LINE EXPEDITION](../themes/tx-14-red-line-expedition.md) | No hat-and-whip silhouettes, named relics, franchise typography or theme melody. |
| [TX-15 PAINTED WIND](../themes/tx-15-painted-wind.md) | No characters, creatures, forest spirits, flying machines or animal-bus vehicles that read as one studio's work, and no studio logo or film titles. |
| [TX-16 PAPER CUT TITLES](../themes/tx-16-paper-cut-titles.md) | No recreations of specific title sequences or posters (a famous spiral, a falling-businessman silhouette, a fragmented-figure layout), and no film titles. |
| [TX-17 SILHOUETTE & SMOKE](../themes/tx-17-silhouette-smoke.md) | No gun-barrel opening, agent-number marks, firearm silhouettes, character names, theme melody or sound-alikes. |
| [TX-18 HALFTONE MULTIVERSE](../themes/tx-18-halftone-multiverse.md) | No spider motifs, masks, suits, webs, franchise logos, or a comics publisher's trade dress. |
| [TX-19 SYMMETRY DIORAMA](../themes/tx-19-symmetry-diorama.md) | No recreations of specific hotels, buildings, vehicles or sets from films, no film titles, no actor likenesses. |
| [TX-20 LIMINAL OFFICE](../themes/tx-20-liminal-office.md) | No company name, logo, founder imagery or mascot from any series, and none of its vocabulary for departments, workers or procedures. |

## This repository is the public edition

This repository is the public edition of the codex. Inspiration names and the shipped-property ledger stay in BHIL's internal brief. The validator enforces this with a salted, hashed deny list, so the list itself never ships. See [ADR-002](../adr/adr-002-public-edition.md).
